comment.text: CEBPA 307-311 is represented as a recurrent in-frame indel region in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Hematologic neoplasms. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting CEBPA the 307-311 region have been observed in hematologic neoplasms.

comment.text: CEBPA N307_E309delinsK is an allele annotation observed in Cancer Hotspots v2 at the 307-311 hotspot or indel region. This documents recurrence in the source cohorts; allele-specific function, tumor-specific significance, reference-sequence mapping, and clinical actionability require independent review.
